Crime & Law · India

Temple donation irregularities investigated in Badrinath and Ayodhya

Investigations have been ordered into alleged donation irregularities at the Badrinath temple in Uttarakhand, with an employee suspended and an FIR filed. Separately, reports indicate an SIT has found evidence against eight individuals in a Ram temple donation theft case in Ayodhya, with a Supreme Court hearing scheduled. The Badrinath temple is managed by a government committee, and allegations involve a parallel committee accepting cash and issuing fake receipts.
